ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Idle`. `beep` is absent: a signal is present only in a tick in which something emits it.
`start`: the transition sets `heating` and emits `beep`. Both are true after this tick.
Nothing fires. `heating` keeps its value, but `beep` is absent again: nothing emitted it in this tick.
`start` again, while the oven is cooking. `Cooking` does not react to `start`, so nothing is emitted.
The door opens: `heating` goes off. This transition emits nothing, so there is no beep.
